name: 10 Minutes Till Dawn
description: Survive a horde of endless Lovecraftian monsters for 10 minutes in this intense roguelike shooter.

name: Arthur's Nightmare
description: Survive the night in Arthur's house while avoiding the terrifying cursed Aardvark family in this viral indie parody horror game by Varun Ramesh.

name: Bad Time Simulator (Sans Fight)
description: Face off against Sans in this legendary recreation of Undertale's ultimate Genocide run boss battle! Dodge bone attacks, platforms, and Gaster Blasters.

name: Baldi's Basics
description: The classic 90s edutainment parody horror game. Collect all 7 notebooks and escape the schoolhouse!

name: Basket Random
description: Hilarious 2-player physics-based ragdoll basketball! Jump, steal, and dunk with wacky controls across changing courts.

name: Basketball Stars
description: Play solo or 1v1 against friends! Choose your favorite legendary basketball stars, shoot three-pointers, and execute thunderous slam dunks.

name: Block Blast!
description: Place block shapes on the 8x8 grid to clear rows and columns and score massive combo streaks!

name: Boxing Random
description: Hilarious physics-based 2-player ragdoll boxing. Jump, punch, and knock out your opponent through changing arenas!

name: Burgers & Frights
description: Ride your bicycle through a pitch-black forest road at night to get a burger in this atmospheric PS1-style retro horror game by Donitz.

name: Clustertruck
description: The chaotic first-person platformer on top of speeding trucks! Leap across unpredictable highway traffic where the floor is literally lava.

name: Crossy Road
description: Why did the chicken cross the road? Dodge high-speed traffic, hop across rushing train tracks, and leap over floating river logs in this endless arcade hit.

name: DELTARUNE (Chapters 1-5)
description: Toby Fox's legendary follow-up to Undertale. Journey into the Dark World with Kris, Susie, and Ralsei across Chapters 1 through 5!

name: DOOM (1993)
description: The legendary 1993 id Software masterpiece. Battle your way through hordes of demons on Phobos with classic weapons and music!

name: DOOM II: Hell on Earth
description: The legendary 1994 id Software classic. Earth has been overrun by demon hordes—grab your Super Shotgun and blast your way through Hell on Earth!

name: Drive Mad
description: High-octane physics-based stunt driving game. Race over wild obstacles without flipping over!

name: Duck Life
description: Train your duckling in running, flying, and swimming to win races and save the farm in the original Flash classic!

name: Duck Life 2: World Champion
description: Compete around the world to become the ultimate duck champion! Train running, flying, swimming, and the all-new climbing skill.

name: Duck Life 3: Evolution
description: Choose from 4 genetically modified duck breeds! Train your duck, evolve through Amateur to Professional leagues, and conquer tournaments.

name: Duck Life 4
description: Embark on a massive adventure across 6 distinct regions from Grassland to Volcano! Train your duck flock, beat rival champions, and claim the trophy.

name: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 1
description: Brad Borne's legendary fast-paced Flash platformer! Run, slide, and wall-jump through Squiggleville in your iconic fancy yellow pants.

name: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 2
description: The beloved World 2 sequel! Help the Fancy Pants Man recover an ice cream cone stolen by an angry rabbit across 6 massive levels.

name: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 3
description: World 3 brings combat with pencils, swimming, and epic pirate battles across the high seas to Squiggleville!

name: FISH
description: A hilarious, action-packed 2D run-and-gun platformer where you play as a fish with a gun.

name: Five Nights at Candy's
description: Survive the night shift at Candy's Burgers and Fries in this legendary Five Nights at Freddy's fan classic.

name: Five Nights at Candy's 2
description: Return to the abandoned warehouse with new mechanics, cameras, and withered animatronics in FNAC 2.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's
description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. Monitor the security cameras and conserve power to survive five nights.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
description: Back with a new cast of characters, the Freddy mask, flashlight, and the music box. Survive the night shift at the new Freddy's!

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
description: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed, Fazbear's Fright brings the horror to life with Springtrap and audio lures.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
description: The final chapter in the original story. Defend yourself in your bedroom against Nightmare Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, and Foxy.

name: Geometry Dash
description: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer. Push your skills to the limit as you leap through treacherous obstacles!

name: Gun Mayhem
description: Legendary arena platform shooter! Battle AI or friends, unlock dozens of crazy weapons, and blast enemies off the stage.

name: Helltaker
description: Short puzzle adventure game about sharply dressed demon girls. Descend into hell for pancakes!

name: Hobo
description: The legendary classic Flash beat 'em up! Wake up in the city dump, brawl against pedestrians and cops, and unlock filthy combos.

name: Hobo 2: Prison Brawl
description: Locked up in maximum security! Battle your way through inmates and riot police to bust out of prison.

name: Hobo 3: Wanted
description: Hobo is now a fugitive on the run! The entire police department is hunting you across city streets, sewers, and rooftops.

name: Hobo 4: Total War
description: The military has been deployed to stop Hobo! Brawl against elite soldiers, tanks, and helicopters using weapons and wild combos.

name: Hobo 5: Space Brawls
description: Abducted into deep space! Aliens cloned an army of Hobos—fight your way through UFOs and reclaim your stolen combos.

name: Hobo 6: Hell
description: Descend into the fiery pits of the underworld! Fight through demon hordes and take the battle straight to Satan himself.

name: Hobo 7: Heaven
description: The epic finale of the Hobo saga. Ascend to the pearly gates, brawl through angels, and confront the creator in Heaven!

name: House of Hazards
description: Hilarious local multiplayer party game. Complete household chores while other players activate dangerous traps against you!

name: Jetpack Joyride
description: Bullet-powered jetpacks! Giant mechanical dragons! Help Barry Steakfries break into a secret laboratory and dodge lasers, zappers, and guided missiles.

name: Minecraft (Eaglercraft 1.12.2)
description: Play real Minecraft 1.12.2 directly in your browser with full singleplayer and multiplayer server support!
Surreal, fast-paced Baldi mod by Mauzer2137. Challenge your math and reflexes in -3!

name: -B
description: The intense surreal Baldi mod sequel by Bermud. Test your math, survival, and reflexes in -B!

name: OneShot Legacy
description: A surreal top-down puzzle adventure game where you guide Niko through a mysterious decaying world.

name: Papa's Burgeria
description: Flip juicy burger patties, stack toppings to order, and serve hungry customers in the legendary Papa's Burgeria!

name: Papa's Cheeseria
description: Craft towering grilled cheese sandwiches loaded with artisan breads, melted cheeses, and savory fillings, paired with seasoned fries in Toastwood!

name: Papa's Donuteria
description: Roll out dough, fry golden donuts, pipe decadent cream fillings, and drizzle icing and sprinkles for amusement park visitors at Powder Point!

name: Papa's Freezeria
description: Mix delicious freezer sundaes, blend syrups, and pile on whipped cream and cherries at the Calypso Island resort!

name: Papa's Hot Doggeria
description: Take charge of the best stadium concession stand at Grilling Stadium! Grill juicy hot dogs, pop sodas, and serve fresh ballpark popcorn.

name: Papa's Pancakeria
description: Cook fluffy pancakes, golden waffles, and French toast stacks topped with butter, fruit, and warm maple syrup in Maple Mountain!

name: Papa's Pastaria
description: Boil al dente pastas, ladel gourmet Italian sauces, and toast fresh garlic bread at your picturesque canal-side trattoria in Portallini!

name: Papa's Pizzeria
description: The original cooking sensation that started it all! Take orders, top pizzas, bake them to perfection, and cut precise slices.

name: Papa's Sushiria
description: Cook nori rice, place fresh salmon and veggies, roll tight sushi maki, slice cleanly, and brew custom bubble teas in Sakura Bay!

name: Papa's Taco Mia!
description: Winner of the taco eating contest? Congratulations, you now run the restaurant! Grill seasoned meats, build tacos, and serve chips & dip.

name: Papa's Wingeria
description: Deep-fry crispy chicken wings, toss them in savory signature sauces, and arrange sides neatly on platters for picky patrons in Starlight City!

name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
description: Welcome to Vice City in 1986. Play Tommy Vercetti climbing to the top of the criminal underworld in this legendary open-world classic.
